about: The Center Events and Catering hosts this Breakfast with Santa in Stow.
It takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.
The address is 4157 Hudson Dr, Stow, Ohio 44224.
The venue describes a festive morning of delicious breakfast food, holiday cheer and a special visit from Santa Claus.
Photos with Santa are part of the morning, so families can bring a camera or phone.
Adult tickets are $30 and children ages 2 to 10 are $15.
Children ages 2 and under are free.
Tickets went on sale November 14 through The Center.
The venue frames the morning as a chance to slow down and spend time with family.
Holiday fun and a keepsake photo round out the event, which is held indoors.
The Center also lists other family events and holiday experiences on its website.

kids: Hear sleigh bells and classic carols live
Meet Santa at a relaxed concert
Move and react freely in a sensory friendly room
about: The New Albany Symphony Orchestra presents this sensory friendly Santa and the Symphony concert.
It is held Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 11:30 AM.
The concert runs about an hour, ending around 12:30 PM according to the New Albany Chamber listing.
The venue is the McCoy Center for the Arts at 100 E Dublin-Granville Rd in New Albany.
The program offers sleigh bells, merry melodies, classic carols and a special visit from Santa.
The sensory friendly series is designed for people on the autism spectrum.
It also welcomes the dementia and Alzheimer's community and young children.
Audience members who need a more relaxed concert experience are welcome too.
Admission is $10 per the New Albany Chamber listing.
Tickets are sold through CAPA, linked from the symphony event page.
Questions can go to the symphony at 614-323-1237.
